name: 3MACross EA
summary: This EA uses a triple moving average crossover system to identify trend direction and generate trade signals. It enters long positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MAs and enters short positions on the reverse crossover. The three MA periods provide layered confirmation to filter out false signals and ensure stronger trend commitment before opening positions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用三重均线交叉系统来识别趋势方向并生成交易信号。当快速均线上穿慢速均线时做多，反向下穿时做空。三条均线提供分层确认，过滤假信号，确保在开仓前有更强的趋势确认。
strategy_analysis: 3MACross EA的核心策略是基于三条不同周期的移动均线交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件：当最短周期均线从下方穿越中间和最长周期均线时做多，反向穿越时做空，三条均线的排列顺序确认趋势强度。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或止损/止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义手数大小，但没有看到动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，提供了止损和止盈参数但缺少账户权益比例计算。该策略的优势在于多重均线确认减少了假突破，但劣势在于趋势滞后性导致入场较晚，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of 3MACross EA is based on the crossover of three moving averages with different periods to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: go long when the shortest-period MA crosses above the middle and longest-period MAs, and go short on the reverse crossover; the alignment order of all three MAs confirms trend strength. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse crossover signals or stop-loss/take-profit settings. Position sizing allows user-defined lot sizes but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters but does not include percentage-of-equity calculation. The advantage of using three MAs is that layered confirmation reduces false breakouts, but the disadvantage is the inherent lag of moving averages causes late entries, and in ranging markets the system tends to generate frequent whipsaw signals leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 三重均线交叉提供多层确认，有效减少假信号
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和优化
适用于趋势明显的市场环境，能捕捉中长期趋势
参数化设计允许灵活调整各均线周期
pros_en: Triple MA crossover provides layered confirmation, effectively reducing false signals
Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize
Performs well in trending markets, capturing medium-to-long-term trends
Parameterized design allows flexible adjustment of each MA period
cons: 均线系统固有滞后性，入场信号往往出现在趋势已经启动之后
在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假交叉信号导致连续亏损
缺少动态仓位管理机制，固定手数无法适应不同市场波动
默认止损止盈为零，存在较大资金风险
cons_en: Inherent lag of moving averages means entry signals often appear after the trend has already started
Prone to frequent whipsaw signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lot size cannot adapt to varying market volatility
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, posing significant capital risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如ADX或ATR）以避免在震荡市中频繁交易
实现基于账户权益比例或ATR的动态仓位管理机制
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., ADX or ATR) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage or ATR volatility

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，若用户忘记设置则无任何风控保护
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线上反复开仓
无仓位检查可能导致重复下单
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero; no risk protection if user forgets to set them
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
No position check could lead to duplicate orders
